back: A satellite navigation system: a receiver times signals from at least four satellites to fix its latitude, longitude, height and the time.
A computer system that captures, stores, analyses and displays data linked to locations.
Layer: one theme of data (roads, rivers). Attribute: information about each feature, held in an attribute table.
AND = intersection (narrows); OR = union (widens); NOT = complement (excludes).
A OR B = A + B − (A AND B): count the overlap once.
Relational: a comparison (slope < 10%). Conditional: IF ... THEN (IF slope < 10% THEN suitable).
Combine layers and test every site against all conditions to find places that satisfy them together.
Cost of equipment and training, need for power, inaccurate or old data ('garbage in, garbage out'), privacy, still needs local knowledge.
